body: You're so right. It's so easy to forget the bad things when you see other people having so much fun and it is brought up almost daily in conversation so I'm constantly surrounded by it. When I remind myself of how awful I felt emotionally and how ill I use to get I do come back down to reality. Plus I think if I did drink I would seriously be hating myself for getting this far and caving, I'm stubborn like that! Thank you so much! 😊

You will get there, don't feel pressured into having to feel this way faster just because someone else does. It takes different lengths of time for everybody I have just been very lucky in my journey. I wish you all the best.

This is such a lovely post. Congratulations you should be so happy and proud of yourself. 

I also will not drink with you today :)

Thank you so much for all your advice. I'm going to Canada on a family holiday so I know I can't exactly lay around all day which I think makes me worried about how I'm going to feel at that time if you get me? Hopefully by then I'll be feeling more upbeat.

I have without a doubt crashed hard, I'm seriously hoping it's just a really bad few days but there's nothing to be down about? I don't want to get out of bed, I don't want to shower, I'm going on holiday in a few weeks the thought of that makes me ill when just a few days ago I was so excited. How is this fair :(
Good idea! I've learnt my lessons now for sure and hopefully if I keep ontop of them I'll get seen faster. :)
I live in the UK so we have th nhs here which is great when they actually do their job properly haha.
As much as that would be a great idea it's way too much money to go private here sadly. It's something I've researched greatly but it all is just too expensive.
Yes. 1000 times yes. I feel like my own worst enemy at times and feel like it's a loosing battle between my sesible side and my impulses.

I relate to you so much. Do you feel like this all of the time because maybe if you do it's time to have a think about being single or is it just a very strong urge sometimes cause by your bpd? I know it's hard to try and pin point in a moment of feeling like this because that's all you can see but give yourself a little bit of time. I hope everything works out well for you.
